verdict.rationale: Plaid explicitly documents liveness/selfie-to-ID matching ('Confirm liveness — Ensure a person is present and their face matches the image on the provided ID') as part of Identity Verification, and risk scoring dashboards show granular checks. However, there is no documented detail on specific anti-spoofing defenses against printed photos, screen replays, or deepfake/video injection attacks, nor any independent certification or hands-on test of liveness robustness. missing for 10: documented defenses against photo/screen/video spoofing, third-party liveness certification (e.g. iBeta/NIST), independent hands-on verification of anti-spoofing efficacy.
